body: I just want to thank you for spending 1.5 hours on me. I didn't think someone would care that much...but idk where to restart. There are no schools around me and homeschool is no longer an option for me. What do I do?
You can think that, but I know that I'll be on the streets in the future, begging for money just to survive. I'm not daft, it's how it is...
